[[Miniature Ghost of Althea]] is a miniature version of the [[Ghost of Althea]].

==Acquisition==

Rare drop from [[Zealot's Chest]] in [[Tunnels of the Forsaken]].

==Notes==

This miniature carries an [[Althea's Staff]] when active.
